extraction_notes: N-channel MOSFET identity and polarity are taken from the product description on p. 2.
Transfer, output, and capacitance traces were digitized from the published plots on p. 4 without interpolation between plotted readings.
The transfer plot identifies 25 °C and 125 °C curves but does not state VDS; the 25 °C curve is reported.
The output and capacitance figures do not state temperature or test frequency in the figure; those conditions are not added to the curve records.
RDS(on) values are transcribed as both typical and inclusive maximum rows for each published VGS and ID condition.
The datasheet provides no explicit revision identifier.
